faqs.question: What should I write in a Halloween card?
faqs.answer: Match the line to the part of the card: a cover headline of 8 words or fewer, a 12 to 25 word quote on the inside-left panel, then your own message and a one-line sign-off on the right. The handwritten message matters most; a quote supports it rather than replacing it.

faqs.question: How long should a Halloween card message be?
faqs.answer: On a standard A2 card (4¼ × 5½ inches), about 40 to 60 handwritten words fit comfortably on the inside-right panel. That figure is our estimate for clear handwriting, not a published standard; on a 5 × 7 card you can roughly double it.

faqs.question: What is a good short quote for the front of a Halloween card?
faqs.answer: Keep it to 8 words or fewer so it reads at arm's length. 'Something wonderful is lurking inside' and 'Warning: contains one friendly ghost' are two originals from this page that work on a cover.

faqs.question: What do you write on a Halloween envelope?
faqs.answer: A short teaser on the flap or bottom-left corner, away from the address and stamp, such as 'Postie, please knock twice' or 'Contents: one card, zero spiders. Probably.' Keep it under 8 words so it never crowds the address.

faqs.question: Can I mail a square Halloween card in the US?
faqs.answer: Yes, but USPS treats a letter as nonmachinable if its length divided by its height is under 1.3, so a square envelope pays a surcharge on top of the letter price. A 5 × 7 card in an A7 envelope stays within standard letter limits.

faqs.question: When should I mail Halloween cards?
faqs.answer: Allow a week. USPS lists First-Class Mail at 1 to 5 days, so post by Friday 23 October 2026 for Saturday 31 October 2026, or Friday 22 October 2027 for Sunday 31 October 2027. We did not verify Royal Mail or other carriers, so allow longer abroad.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to mail a Halloween postcard?
faqs.answer: USPS listed postcards from $0.65 and letters from $0.82 when checked on 13 October 2026. The postcard price applies only to cards no larger than 4¼ × 6 inches; a folded greeting card in an envelope goes at the letter price.

faqs.question: What do kids write on Halloween cards for classmates?
faqs.answer: One short, sweets-free line with a name blank, like a Valentine's swap card: 'You make recess less scary' or 'Owl always save you a seat'. Keep it to 12 words or fewer so young readers get big letters.

faqs.question: Can I use a Shakespeare quote on a handmade Halloween card?
faqs.answer: Yes. Shakespeare's plays are public domain; copy the line from a plain text such as Project Gutenberg's A Midsummer Night's Dream and credit him under it. Puck's 'Following darkness like a dream' is short enough for cover lettering.

faqs.question: Is a handwritten Halloween card better than a text?
faqs.answer: For keeping, usually yes. In a 2023 BMC Public Health study of the #KindnessByPost card exchange, people kept their cards and went back to them, and a shop-bought card without a handwritten message could disappoint. A text or a link wins on speed when the post is too slow.

faqs.question: Can I send a Halloween card if it is too late to post one?
faqs.answer: Yes. SubhSandesh's /happy-halloween page arrives as a private link the same day: you add a letter, up to six photos and a word for the pumpkin, and they open it as a little haunted house. It is built for one recipient, not a group.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Halloween Quotes for Cards: 57 Lines Sized to Each Card Part

The best Halloween quotes for cards are sized for their spot: a cover headline of 8 words or fewer, a 12 to 25 word quote inside, a one-line sign-off, an envelope teaser and a short postcard back. Below are 57 original lines sorted by card part, plus 4 public-domain lines checked against Project Gutenberg.

A mailed card needs about a week, yet people decide late: on SubhSandesh, 49.4% of Raksha Bandhan 2026 pages were built on the festival day itself, and not one was built more than 7 days ahead. That is our nearest analogue (no Halloween usage data exists), so this page ends with posting dates and a same-day option.

## What makes a Halloween quote work on a card?

A Halloween card quote is a short line written for a fixed space on paper, so the card sets its length. A cover line must read from arm's length; the inside can carry a full thought.

The space is small. A US postcard that qualifies for card postage is at most 4¼ × 6 inches under the [USPS Domestic Mail Manual, section 101](https://pe.usps.com/text/dmm300/101.htm). Quotes longer than 25 words crowd out the part people keep: your own handwriting.

## 57 original Halloween quotes for cards, sorted by card part

Every line is original and clean enough for a classroom or a grandparent. Swap [name] for the recipient or yourself.

### 1. Front-of-card headlines: 9 lines, 8 words or fewer

These must read at a glance. Write them large.

- Something wonderful is lurking inside.
- Open slowly. The bats are still asleep.
- Hello from the haunted side of town.
- Warning: contains one friendly ghost.
- Pumpkins lit, porch swept, thinking of you.
- A little spooky, mostly sweet.
- Knock twice. A note is waiting.
- Moonrise, candlelight and you on my mind.
- From our cauldron to your doorstep.

### 2. Inside-left quotes: 8 lines, 12 to 25 words

This panel faces your message and sets its mood. Match it to the person.

- Every carved pumpkin was once a plain one that someone decided to light from the inside.
- The best part of a dark night is the window someone left glowing for you.
- Ghosts are memories that refuse to leave the room, and some of my favourite ones are you.
- October hands out masks so everyone can be brave for one evening.
- A full moon, a cold street and a warm hand to hold: that is the whole recipe.
- Fear is loud for a moment. Laughter echoes for years.
- Some treats come in wrappers; the best ones arrive in envelopes.
- On the night of a thousand masks, the people who know your real face matter most.

### 3. Inside-right sign-offs: 8 lines

It sits under your message. One line keeps your name last.

- With love and one stolen toffee, [name]
- Yours from beyond the fog, [name]
- Your favourite ghost, [name]
- Sealed with a spell and a smile, [name]
- Haunting you kindly until next October, [name]
- Bats, cats and hugs, [name]
- Save me a pumpkin seed. Love, [name]
- Fondly, the crooked jack-o'-lantern household

### 4. Envelope teasers: 7 lines for the front or the flap

Everyone sees the envelope first, carrier included. Write on the flap, away from the address and stamp.

- Do not open before 31 October.
- Contents: one card, zero spiders. Probably.
- Handle gently: a ghost is napping inside.
- Special delivery from the pumpkin patch.
- Postie, please knock twice.
- Sealed at midnight. Read by daylight.
- Treat inside. No tricks, promise.

### 5. Postcard backs: 6 lines, 15 to 25 words

The address and stamp take half the back. These read like a short dispatch.

- Greetings from the land of long shadows. We carved three pumpkins and burnt two trays of cookies.
- The trees have gone full orange and the neighbours put a skeleton on the roof. Thinking of you.
- Fog this morning, sparklers tonight. The kids are a dragon and a toaster. Miss you on our porch.
- No ghosts sighted yet, but the cat is suspicious. Happy Halloween from all four of us.
- Halloween is not the same without your terrible jokes. Call me on the 31st.
- Wrote this by lamplight with a pumpkin watching. It insists I say hello.

### 6. Handmade-card lettering quotes: 9 lines, 2 to 5 words

Short lines are easiest to hand-letter or stencil. Pencil first, then ink.

- Hey, boo.
- Stay spooky, stay kind.
- Brewing up good wishes.
- Witching you well.
- Glow on, little pumpkin.
- Bats about you.
- Full moon, full heart.
- Moon-sized hugs.
- Hocus pocus, you're my focus.

### 7. Classroom card swaps: 10 lines for kids

These work like Valentine's swap cards, one per classmate. None mention sweets, so they suit any classroom rule.

- To ____: you are my favourite pumpkin in the patch!
- You make recess less scary. Happy Halloween!
- I would share my last gummy worm with you.
- Our class is the friendliest haunted house.
- You're a-maze-ing, just like a corn maze.
- Batty about our class!
- Owl always save you a seat.
- You make our classroom glow.
- Thanks for being a spook-tacular reading buddy.
- No tricks today, just high fives.

## 4 public-domain lines for a Halloween card, from Project Gutenberg

These are copied from the [Project Gutenberg text of A Midsummer Night's Dream](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1514) (first printed 1600) and [Longfellow's Complete Poetical Works](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1365).

> "Now it is the time of night / That the graves, all gaping wide, / Every one lets forth his sprite" (Shakespeare, *A Midsummer Night's Dream*, Puck, 1600)
>
> "Following darkness like a dream" (Shakespeare, *A Midsummer Night's Dream*, Puck, 1600)
>
> "I am sent with broom before, / To sweep the dust behind the door." (Shakespeare, *A Midsummer Night's Dream*, Puck, 1600)
>
> "All houses wherein men have lived and died / Are haunted houses." (Longfellow, "Haunted Houses", 1858)

## How many words fit on each part of a Halloween card?

Card sizes are trade conventions: A2 cards sell at 4¼ × 5½ inches, A7 at 5 × 7 inches, and the UK's A6 at 105 × 148 mm. The limits below are our estimates for clear handwriting on an A2 card, not a standard.

| Card part | Max words (our estimate) | Tone | Example from this page |
|---|---|---|---|
| Front headline or lettering | 8 | Bold, playful | Something wonderful is lurking inside. |
| Inside-left quote | 25 | Reflective | Fear is loud for a moment. |
| Inside-right message and sign-off | 40 to 60 | Warm, personal | Haunting you kindly until next October, [name] |
| Envelope teaser | 8 | Mischievous | Postie, please knock twice. |
| Postcard back or swap card | 25 | Newsy, cheerful | No ghosts sighted yet. |

On an A7 card, roughly double the inside numbers. USPS treats a letter as nonmachinable if length divided by height is under 1.3, so square cards pay a surcharge, while a 5 × 7 card in an A7 envelope fits the 11½ × 6⅛ inch letter limit.

## Handwriting tips that keep a Halloween card readable

Recipients notice effort. In a [2023 BMC Public Health study of the #KindnessByPost card exchange](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC10694983), 20 interviewees kept cards and returned to them to lift their mood, while a shop-bought card without a handwritten message could disappoint.

Legibility is the other half. A [2026 qualitative study of 10 adults aged 67 to 93 with vision loss](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC13395829) found handwriting was often kept for meaningful writing such as cards, and one participant worried messy writing looked like low effort. Low-tech aids such as bold-lined paper helped.

- Use a dark pen on a pale card; orange ink on black card is hard to read.
- Write your message first and the quote last.
- Print the cover line in capitals and the inside in your usual hand.

## When to post a Halloween card: allow a week

Post by Friday 23 October 2026 for Saturday 31 October 2026, and by Friday 22 October 2027 for Sunday 31 October 2027. USPS lists [First-Class Mail at 1 to 5 days](https://www.usps.com/ship/mail-shipping-services.htm), with postcards from $0.65 and letters from $0.82 (checked 13 October 2026). Outside the US we did not verify times, so allow a week, longer abroad.

The $0.65 card price applies only up to 4¼ × 6 inches. A folded 5 × 7 card goes at the letter price, and a square one costs more again.

## A same-day Halloween card when the post is too slow

If it is 29 October and the card is still blank, a [Halloween card they open as a little haunted house](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) arrives as a private link. You add a letter, up to six photos and a word to carve on the pumpkin; they knock three times and read your letter by flashlight. You get an email the first time they answer "Will you be my boo?" (editable, up to 60 characters).

It has partner, bestie, family and kids modes; the kids tone has no gore or jump scares. It is a one-person page, not a party invitation.

The [premium Halloween page with a voice note](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) adds a 60-second voice note and up to 12 photos. A link suits phone readers: 48.3% of SubhSandesh pages are opened on one, platform-wide.

## When a paper card beats a Halloween link

Paper wins when the card itself is the gift. The #KindnessByPost participants kept and displayed their post, which a link cannot do on a fridge door. Classroom swaps need paper too, since the point is a stack of small cards to hand out.

Paper also wins for a grandparent who rarely opens links and for a card signed by a whole class. Our rule: post a card if you are ahead of 23 October, and send a link if you are behind it.

## Sources

- Scott et al., #KindnessByPost realist interview study, *BMC Public Health*, 4 December 2023.
- Anwar, Macnaughton and Latham, writing needs of older adults with vision loss, *Ophthalmic & Physiological Optics*, 10 June 2026.
- United States Postal Service, Domestic Mail Manual 101 and Mail and Shipping Services, checked 13 October 2026.
- Shakespeare, *A Midsummer Night's Dream*, Project Gutenberg eBook #1514; Longfellow, *Complete Poetical Works*, eBook #1365.
